verdict.rationale: Netlify documents a REST API for managing sites, deploys and DNS, but the pack never says a machine-readable spec for it can be downloaded. The probe of common OpenAPI and Swagger paths on docs.netlify.com returned 404 everywhere. The llms.txt file and the Markdown versions of doc pages are documentation formats, not an API spec, so they are only adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
